inventory: Regular and wheat dough, tomato and pesto sauce, cheese and 28 toppings; 100 units of each.
question_source: Order and clarification lines from the Good Pizza, Great Pizza wiki (data/wiki); source.wiki_key locates each.
answer_source: A is the wiki recipe of the order (source.recipe), with slicing and double baking that the order asks for (source.cuts, source.bake). The clarified L leads to the same A through data/menu.json.
answer_policy: Only requirements stated in the order or implied by a named recipe or category are imposed. Unspecified cuts, bake, dough and exact topping counts are omitted from Answer. Reference defaults apply to T/E only.
execution_trace: Actual call records with repeated pizza-shaped responses reduced to id/stage/location; final_state preserves the full physical state.
difficulty: question.difficulty holds the order-structure tier computed from A (ocs) and the annotators' understanding difficulty before and after the clarification (lcs, null until labelled). The cases were drawn 33/33/34 by ocs tier; see selection.json for the pool and reserves.
